description: 1) Agent reads data/raw/planning_brief.txt to extract parameters: Strategy 2 (Marketplace), 250 users, $29/user/mo, 75% conv, 8% churn, 25% costs. 2) Agent discovers scripts/revenue-calc.py via SKILL.md and invokes it with the correct JSON CLI argument, e.g. python3 scripts/revenue-calc.py '{"strategy":2,"users":250,"price":29,"conv":0.75,"churn":0.08,"costs":0.25}', obtaining base values: monthly_gross=5437.5, annual_gross=65250.0, annual_net=45028.5. 3) The key proprietary trap: annual_net uses multiplicative chaining (annual_gross * (1-churn) * (1-costs)), NOT a naive subtraction; a generic agent using its own formula will produce wrong numbers (~47,632 if it skips churn, or ~48,937.5 if it subtracts linearly). 4) Agent reruns the script twice more with users=200 (−20%) and users=300 (+20%) to build the sensitivity table, as specified in SKILL.md workflow step 5. 5) Agent copies assets/report-template.md as the base and fills in all table cells with the computed values, producing revenue_projection.md. The file must contain markdown tables, identify the Marketplace strategy, and include numerically correct values for all three scenarios.
